20213.long_desc: This professional-grade 23.8-inch Arcooda LCD touchscreen monitor is perfect for any arcade machine. It features a 16:9 display and accepts both VGA and HDMI inputs, supporting resolutions from 15khz/25Khz/31khz up to 1920 x 1080 Full HD. With its low response time, excellent color depth, and included mounting frame, it's an ideal replacement monitor. Its all-black metal casing, mounting brackets, and separate adjustment board make installation incredibly simple, even for those with limited technical experience. Just connect your game boards and cables, and you're ready to play! This ease of use also applies if you're using an RGB input. If you are using RGB input, you need to also purchase this RGB to VGA Adapter Board This is a premium arcade monitor with 1.3ms display lag testing results (Leo Bodnar), VGA/HDMI input and breakout monitor adjustment board with extension cable, and mounting brackets. Designed specifically for Arcooda's Mercury cabinet, this monitor offers the ultimate versatility: seamlessly switch between JAMMA arcade games, HDMI sources, and even touchscreen PC gaming. When connected to your Steam or Epic Games accounts, the touchscreen eliminates the need for a keyboard and mouse, allowing for simple, direct interaction with just a touch.
